policy.stoppingRule: Stop at the first actual ordinary newborn with accepted head-structure variation and its real parent IDs. Retain all attempted seeds and all siblings in that birth event. Untested seeds are not outcomes.
policy.interventions: Each independent targeted world starts with two disclosed unrelated adult founders, assigned opposite sexes and initialized once to maturity+2 and full species reserves. Existing supported dry habitat is selected by the unchanged fixture helper. No forced acceptance, repeated recovery reset, body/trait injection, new food, mutation boost, endpoint placement, or gestation shortcut. Parents/offspring then follow ordinary updates.
policy.limitation: Targeted staged founding pair, not ordinary player discovery, autonomous encounter frequency, full-genome/physical calibration acceptance or integrated100-day trial.
